title: Wings live: Capitol Theatre, Cardiff | 1975
content:
Wings performed at the Capitol Theatre in Cardiff, Wales, on 11 September 1975.

It was the third night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

The Beatles had performed at the Capitol Theatre on 27 May 1963 and 12 December 1965. Wings had played there during the Wings 1973 UK Tour on 13 May 1973.
